angle.description: Direction the fish faces in its texture. Compass strings and degrees run clockwise from the top.

plaque_rotation_up.description: Clockwise angle from the texture's top toward the direction that should point up on the plaque. Null until calibrated.

plaque_rotation_vert_flipped.description: Flip vertically across the plaque's horizontal axis after rotation. Null until calibrated.

averageLengthCm.description: The fish's average collectible length in centimeters. Each catch's rolled length also determines its physically scaled shadow.

lengthDeviationCm.description: Optional override for the distance from the average that fewer than 1% of catches exceed. Defaults to one third of averageLengthCm.

textureLengthPixels.description: The fish's opaque length projected onto its facing direction and normalized to a 16-pixel item frame. Generate this value from texture.png and angle.

catching.description: Optional overrides for the stable catching behavior generated from the fish id and rarity.

approachSeconds.description: Seconds for a bounce approach from retreatDistance back to the bobber. The first arrival scales its duration to use this same speed.

retreatDistance.description: Blocks the fish backs away after touching the bobber. This is added to the size-based contact distance.

averageCatchSeconds.description: Baseline time used to rank this species' bite tendency relative to other fish.

tags.description: Spawn conditions. Tags in one category use OR. Tags in different categories use AND. Climate tags apply in the Overworld. Nether biome tags apply in the Nether. End biome and void height tags apply in the End.
